issues.description: The problem statement and UML specify a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int, but the solution implements getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests). This parameter mismatch means students implementing the method as specified in the exercise will not match the solution's API (and vice versa), causing confusion and potential compilation/signature mismatches when following the instructions or comparing to the reference implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent: either (A) change the solution to implement a no-argument getTotalNumberOfStudents() that returns the total number of students (including guests) and update calls (e.g., getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents and getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor) to use the no-arg method; or (B) update the problem statement and UML to document getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) and explain the parameter behaviour. Preferred fix: implement getTotalNumberOfStudents() with no parameters returning inscribed + guest students to match the exercise description.
